title: Transfusion: Predict the Next Token and Diffuse Images with One Multi-Modal Model
layout_note: One wide grey Transformer slab between an input row (words, <BOI>, four noisy image patches, <EOI>, words) below and an output row above (words in blue boxes shifted one position, a dashed empty box, four clean image patches inside one red frame, words in blue boxes).
grouping: No containers except one red rectangle around the four output image patches; every other output token sits in its own blue-outlined box.
shapes_depth: Flat: a wide light-grey rectangle with thin dark outline for the Transformer; plain text words and small image patches as inputs; blue-outlined square boxes for output text tokens, a dashed grey empty box, a red rectangle grouping the output patches. Short straight vertical arrows, one per position, below and above the slab.
proposed_highlight: No module is highlighted; the method's point is carried by the two output kinds: text outputs in blue boxes shifted one step right of their inputs, image outputs as clean patches grouped in a red frame above noisy input patches.
lesson: Show two objectives in one model by the outputs alone: text targets shifted one position (next-token) in one box style, image patches noisy below and clean above (denoising) in a differently coloured frame.
notes: Venue written as arXiv: the arXiv PDF states no venue; the candidate list gives ICLR 2025 (unverified). year = arXiv preprint year. The image patches are embedded images (photo_share). The dashed empty output box sits above the <BOI> input position.

arrangement.units: one row of positions: input tokens under a single Transformer slab and output tokens over it; only the output image patches are enclosed (red frame)
arrangement.inputs_as: plain words of a caption and a question ('A cute cat .', 'What color is its nose') with <BOI>/<EOI> markers around four noisy real image patches
arrangement.losses_at: not labelled; the objectives are implied by the output row (shifted words in blue boxes, clean patches in a red frame)
arrangement.shared: one Transformer slab spans every position, text and image alike

taxonomy.task: one transformer trained with next-token prediction on text and diffusion on image patches in a single interleaved sequence

insights.structure: A single slab spans one interleaved sequence, inputs below and outputs above, one column per position.
insights.data: Text is the actual words and images are actual patches: noisy versions in the input row and clean versions in the output row.
insights.emphasis: The image outputs are grouped by a red frame while text outputs sit in individual blue boxes, so the two prediction kinds differ at a glance.
insights.flow: Short straight vertical arrows, one per position, up into and out of the Transformer; the text outputs are shifted one position right of their inputs.
insights.avoid: Neither objective is named or keyed in the figure and the dashed empty box above <BOI> is unexplained, so the red-vs-blue distinction relies on the caption.

core.what: one Transformer slab spans an interleaved sequence of words and image patches, with text predicted next-token and patches denoised in the same output row

relations.form: a single wide slab spanning every input position, text and image
two output treatments in one row: blue-boxed words shifted one position right vs four clean patches grouped in a red frame directly above their noisy inputs
one column per position, bottom to top: input token, arrow, Transformer, arrow, output

channels.colour: output box colour = prediction kind: blue outline = text token, red frame = image patches; the slab is neutral grey
channels.shape: boxed cells = output tokens, plain words and patch images = inputs, one wide rectangle = the model
channels.line: short vertical arrows = per-position data flow only; dashed outline = an empty output slot
channels.frame: the red rectangle = one image as a unit of output

quality.strengths: Data drawn as data (real words, noisy and clean patches); the next-token shift and noisy-to-clean denoising are visible from position alone; one meaning per channel; all lines short, straight and aligned in columns.
quality.weaknesses: The two objectives are not named or keyed, the dashed empty box above <BOI> is unexplained, and the attention pattern (causal for text, bidirectional within an image) is not shown; the plain grey slab gives no hint where the modalities are treated differently.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)
